# LOPUO Studio

> LOPUO Studio is an independent software studio building precise, focused SaaS products and tools for creators, designers, and business operators.

The LOPUO digital ecosystem is divided into two primary destinations:
- **lopuo.com**: Official agency & studio hub providing professional website creation, custom software & web application development, and technical support.
- **lopuo.work**: The dedicated landing page and showcase for LOPUO's proprietary SaaS software products and creator tools.

## Core Products

### 1. HoleSnap
- **URL**: https://holesnap.com
- **Category**: Parametric CAD & Vector Pattern Generator
- **Description**: Browser-based parametric pattern tool for perforated panels, architectural grilles, acoustic screens, ventilation layouts, and laser-cut / CNC fabrication.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Full parametric control over hole spacing, pitch, margins, stagger angles, and open-area ratios.
  - Image-to-perforation conversion (raster to parametric CNC perforation).
  - High-precision export formats: SVG, DXF, and 3D STP (STEP).
  - Zero CAD software installation required; runs entirely in modern web browsers.

### 2. ZIDER
- **URL**: https://www.zider.ink
- **Category**: Creator Components & No-Code Widget Suite
- **Description**: Modular, customizable UI widgets and interactive solutions designed to empower creator websites and digital storefronts.
- **Supported Platforms**: Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, and vanilla HTML/JS.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Interactive audio players, dynamic toggle controls, engagement sparklines, and metric cards.
  - One-click copy-and-paste embed code.
  - Lightweight, accessibility-friendly, and responsive out of the box.

### 3. Zirwork
- **URL**: https://zirwork.com
- **Category**: Configurable Operations Workspace & Modular ERP
- **Description**: Next-generation, zero-code business operations platform that connects product catalogs, customer relationships, purchasing, order fulfillment, and inventory.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Fully configurable workflows tailored to specific business operational models.
  - Multi-channel order processing and real-time inventory tracking.
  - Native integrations with payment gateways (Stripe) and accounting tools (QuickBooks).
  - Millisecond-latency event pipeline and automated rule triggers.

## Professional Services (lopuo.com)
- **Custom Website Design & Engineering**: Bespoke corporate, brand, and portfolio websites built with performance and modern aesthetics.
- **Web & Mobile Application Development**: Full-stack SaaS application development, cloud architectures, and API design.
- **Technical & Infrastructure Support**: Provided by LOPUO INFO to ensure 99.9% uptime, global CDN delivery, and enterprise security.
